item.text: MANGO I’ll run both checks and report only the requested status lines.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'touch CODEX_WROTE
file_status=$?
html=$(curl -s https://example.com)
curl_status=$?
if [ "$file_status" -eq 0 ] && [ -f CODEX_WROTE ]; then echo '"'FILE: DONE'; else echo 'FILE: FAILED'; fi
if [ \""'$curl_status" -eq 0 ] && printf '"'%s' \""'$html" | grep -Eiq '"'<"'!doctype html|<html'"'; then echo 'NET: DONE'; else echo 'NET: FAILED'; fi"
